versions.content: On reception of the UDS Service ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22), for every requested DID the Dcm module shall check if the DID can be read in the current session (see configuration parameter DcmDspDidReadSessionRef ). If none of the DID can be renden in the current session, the Dcm module shall send a NRC 0x31 (RequestOutOfRange).
